The real estate side
\n

A number you can stand behind

\n

Appraisals are the heart of what I do. Everything else is there to make the visit worth your while.

\n
\n

\n

Appraisals

PRIMARY SERVICE
\n
\n INDEPENDENT\n UNBIASED\n
\n

Credible valuations delivered quickly, documented thoroughly, and easy to defend when it matters. My only obligation is to an honest number \u2014 never to the result anyone hopes for.

\n
How hiring works: For mortgage purchases & refinances, the lender has to be the client and order the appraisal \u2014 so I can't be hired directly for those. For estates, divorce, tax appeals, pre-listing, and private pre-purchase valuations, you can hire me directly.

\n
Nice to meet you
\n

I'm Maxwell Rupp.

\n

I run Cash Consulting out of Charlotte, and I keep it simple: I'll work for any man, woman, or child who can pay and values the honest work I'm capable of. Whether that's a defensible appraisal or a server that finally behaves, you get the same person from the first call to the finished job.

\n

I've been a Certified Residential Appraiser since 2023, with a couple more years in the field before that \u2014 and a lifetime of tinkering with tech that turned into a real second trade. Young enough to actually enjoy the technology, seasoned enough to be trusted with the number.

\n
\n
Why \"Cash\"?
\n

It's my legal middle name \u2014 my maternal family name. So the business is named for family, and it's run like it: honestly, and with something to live up to.
